name: @ogretmenrehberi/sunum-web
description: Netlify'da yayımlanan, kumandayla yönetilen şifreli ders sunumu.

scripts.test:content: node scripts/build.mjs && node ../lesson-player/scripts/test-presentation-content-validation.mjs && node scripts/test-presentation-flow.mjs && node scripts/test-presentation-integrity.mjs --static-only
scripts.test: npm run test:content && node scripts/test-data.mjs && node scripts/test-textbook-pdf-links.mjs && node scripts/test-assessment-forms.mjs && node scripts/test-pptx-export.mjs && node scripts/test-offline-assets.mjs && node scripts/test-assessment-materials.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run test:browser:built
scripts.test:browser:built: node scripts/test-offline-assets.mjs && node scripts/test-assessment-forms-browser.mjs && VISUAL_LAYOUT_CLASS_SMOKE=1 node scripts/test-presentation-browser.mjs && node scripts/test-presentation-browser.mjs && node scripts/test-offline-browser.mjs && node scripts/test-presentation-integrity.mjs
scripts.test:browser:ci: node scripts/test-assessment-forms-browser.mjs && VISUAL_LAYOUT_CLASS_SMOKE=1 node scripts/test-presentation-browser.mjs && node scripts/test-presentation-browser.mjs && node scripts/test-offline-browser.mjs && node scripts/test-presentation-integrity.mjs
scripts.test:offline: npm run build && node scripts/test-offline-assets.mjs && node scripts/test-offline-browser.mjs
